channel.description: Latest articles from West Hawaii Today (westhawaiitoday.com)

item.title: Judge orders ICE chief to appear in court over potential contempt
item.description: In a remarkable display of frustration, the chief federal judge in Minnesota ordered the head of U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement to appear in court Friday to explain why he should not be held in contempt for violating court orders arising from the Trump administration’s aggressive immigration crackdown in the state.

item.title: Border czar Tom Homan meets Minnesota Gov. Tim Walz as Trump seeks to calm Minneapolis ICE crackdown
item.description: President Donald Trump’s newly appointed head of the ICE crackdown in Minnesota met with Democratic Gov. Tim Walz on Tuesday as the White House sought to lower the political temperature following the killing of American citizen Alex Pretti by immigration agents last Saturday.

item.title: US officially leaves the Paris Climate Agreement. For the second time
item.description: As of Tuesday, the United States is no longer a party to the Paris agreement on climate change, becoming the only country in the world to abandon the international commitment to slow global warming.

item.title: Toronto man accused of posing as pilot pleads not guilty
item.description: A 33-year-old Toronto man pleaded not guilty Friday to wire fraud charges after he allegedly posed as a pilot or flight attendant to book more than 200 airline tickets “at no cost” on four different carriers, according to federal court documents.

item.title: As Trump promotes economy in Iowa, many residents feel pain
item.description: President Donald Trump headed to Iowa on Tuesday to once again try to convince Americans that he is focused on “affordability.” He had some explaining to do.

item.title: Trump, seeking damage control, weighs less aggressive approach in Minneapolis
item.description: WASHINGTON/Minn. — President Donald Trump’s border czar, Tom Homan, met with the Minneapolis mayor and the Minnesota governor on Tuesday in a show of detente, as the White House sought to ease unrest gripping the city after two U.S. citizens were shot dead by federal agents.

item.title: Reports: Bill Belichick fails to make Pro Football HOF on first ballot
item.description: Bill Belichick will not make the Pro Football Hall of Fame in his first year on the ballot, ESPN and The Athletic reported Tuesday.

item.title: Seven big names who could be traded before MLB Opening Day
item.description: Last week we ranked the seven best MLB free agents still on the open market, and now we’re going to break down the biggest names who could be traded between now and Opening Day.

item.title: Annual Volcano Art Center fundraiser is Feb. 21
item.description: The Love The Arts annual fundraiser event, “Earth, Wind &Fire,” takes place from 4:30 p.m. to 8:30 p.m. on Saturday, Feb. 21, at Volcano Art Center’s Niaulani Campus in Volcano Village (19-4074 Old Volcano Road).

item.title: Tokuda to host town-hall meeting in Waimea
item.description: This week, U.S. Rep. Jill Tokuda, D-District 2, will begin a series of town-hall meetings in every county of Hawaii.
